units.title: A reel you can pause, inspect and question
units.summary: mutoscope turns a source into a single HTML reel: play, pause, scrub, click into anything and ask about the exact moment.

claims.text: A reel is one HTML file the viewer can play, pause, scrub, click into and ask about.

refs.quote: the reel is a single HTML file the viewer can play, pause, scrub, click into, and ask questions about.
Turn a pull request, a codebase, an article, a concept or an incident into an interactive, discussable animated reel.

units.title: The stage and its claims
units.summary: Scenes play on a stage with captions; the side panel lists the scene's claims, each tagged evidence or inference, and the chapters.

claims.text: Every claim is tagged evidence or inference.

refs.quote: Every claim is tagged evidence (must cite a source ref) or inference.
Every claim is tagged evidence (must cite a source ref) or inference.

units.title: Inspect anything
units.summary: Clicking an element pauses playback and shows its explanation, sources and, for charts, the exact data and where it came from.

claims.text: Clicking into the reel is part of the viewing model.

refs.quote: the reel is a single HTML file the viewer can play, pause, scrub, click into, and ask questions about.

claims.text: The screenshot shows a chart's dataset and values in Inspect.

units.title: Ask, answer, sync
units.summary: Questions carry the moment; live sessions reach your own agent, published reels open a GitHub Discussion. Answers are posted only after the author approves them, and sync back into the reel.

claims.text: Questions are anchored to scene, element and time and land as GitHub Discussions.

refs.quote: Published reels take questions from other viewers, anchored to scene + entity + timestamp; they land as GitHub Discussions.

claims.text: Nothing is posted without explicit approval.

refs.quote: nothing is posted without explicit approval
Published reels take questions from other viewers, anchored to scene + entity + timestamp; they land as GitHub Discussions.

units.title: What it needs
units.summary: Collaboration runs on GitHub Discussions; snapshots and video export need Chromium, and MP4 export needs ffmpeg.

claims.text: MP4 export needs ffmpeg; snapshots need a one-time browser install.
